meta.name: uae-pdp-law
meta.description: Implements compliance with the UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data (UAE PDP Law) and its Executive Regulations. Covers data controller and processor obligations, data subject rights, cross-border transfer requirements, sensitive data processing, and UAE Data Office enforcement. Keywords: UAE PDP, Federal Decree-Law 45, UAE Data Office, DIFC, ADGM, cross-border transfer.
